status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task (only one allowed).
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Prepare and test the phone
features.user_visible_behavior: Download required assets, show truthful progress and retry states, and run local generation on the phone.
verification: On Honor X9c over HTTPS, load the model and inspect supported and absent-answer checks in English and Filipino.
Disconnect internet, close and reopen the app, and generate with a newly initialized engine using cached assets.
Export actual device/browser, model/version, output, duration, and failure evidence; desktop checks do not satisfy phone acceptance.
evidence: 2026-10-10: npm ci and npm run verify passed; 5 unit tests and production build.

2026-10-10: npm run test:browser passed 4 desktop Chrome checks, including simulated worker controls, persistence/export, storage failures, responsive layout and offline app shell. No actual phone inference evidence.
Detailed observed results and pending phone acceptance: verification/phone-setup.md; phone procedure: README.md.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Verify local device capability before promising offline AI. Time-box feasibility to approximately 45 minutes; resolve failure before dependent implementation. | Approved OpenSpec change: offline-photo-reviewer-mvp, task group 1.

features.title: Capture and confirm printed source
features.user_visible_behavior: Capture or select up to two photos for one lesson, OCR them locally and sequentially, and confirm editable extracted text beside each image.
verification: Process fresh printed-page photos containing English and Filipino text on the phone.
Retain photos, raw OCR, corrected text, and page references separately; require explicit confirmation.
Exercise poor/empty OCR recovery and visible rejection or narrowing of oversized input.
Edit confirmed source and verify older generated items, answers, and quiz progress are invalidated.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Confirm extracted source before deriving study material. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass.

features.title: Generate a source-linked reviewer
features.user_visible_behavior: Generate and save approximately five short study items in the selected English or Filipino response language, with source-page references and verbatim quotations.
verification: Generate items from confirmed corrected text and inspect answer meaning against visible source evidence in both response languages.
Validate output structure, page IDs, text bounds, and exact quotations; reject malformed or unsupported output.
Allow at most one bounded retry and verify failed generation preserves previously completed saved work.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Visible source evidence makes generated study material inspectable; quotation matching alone does not prove answer correctness. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass.

features.title: Practice with cards and a scored quiz
features.user_visible_behavior: Flip cards and complete three multiple-choice questions reused from the study items, with deterministic scoring and source-backed feedback after wrong answers.
verification: Flip the generated cards and answer all three quiz questions.
Check correct and incorrect selections using stable choice IDs; inspect distractors for ambiguity.
After an incorrect selection, show the correct answer, supporting source, and a short explanation.
If explanation generation fails, retain the correct answer and source; verify successfully saved quiz progress survives reopening.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Reuse facts across study modes and deterministically score explicit choices. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass.

features.title: Ask about the lesson
features.user_visible_behavior: Ask short lesson-grounded questions in English or Filipino, view validated supporting evidence, and receive a clear response when an answer is absent.
verification: Ask supported and absent-answer questions in both English and Filipino on the phone and inspect meaning.
Verify returned page references and quotations against the current confirmed source.
Reject invalid evidence and exercise understandable busy, failure, and retry states.
Verify source content is treated as untrusted lesson data and completed work remains available during failures.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Bounded lesson help with visible evidence lets students inspect generated answers. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass.

features.title: Reopen and create offline
features.user_visible_behavior: Restore one saved lesson and quiz progress and create new review content after cold offline reopening without internet or a running development laptop.
verification: Disconnect internet, switch off the laptop, close the app, and reopen it.
Verify photos, corrected source, generated items, and quiz progress are restored.
Process fresh photos and run OCR, reviewer generation, quiz feedback, and chat using cached assets.
Inspect network behavior and verify missing or evicted assets produce truthful readiness and recovery states.
Simulate failed storage writes and confirm no false saved label; verify cache cleanup preserves model assets.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Durable offline sessions preserve study continuity; an already-loaded tab does not demonstrate cold offline readiness. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass.

features.title: Reproduce and demonstrate the product
features.user_visible_behavior: Provide reproducible setup instructions, tested limitations, technology disclosures, and a short demonstration of the complete verified flow.
verification: Follow documented setup from a clean checkout and run the configured verification commands.
Record tested phone/browser, package/model revisions, initial download requirements, observed latency, and unresolved limitations.
Prepare a roughly one-minute demonstration covering fresh capture, correction, generated reviewer, quiz/chat, and offline reopening.
Verify OpenSpec coverage and UI delivery checks against actual evidence before claiming the MVP complete.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Reproducible demonstrations and disclosures support honest evaluation. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass.
